environment.scope: Swift Testing controlled inputs, mock persistence/clock and Debug UI fixtures; not hardware qualification.

system-thermal-state.observed: ProcessInfo known four values and unknown mapping; omitted injection fails closed, nominal with invalid CPU remains invalid.

cpu-assessment.observed: Raw rather than EMA; below/pending/sustained/recovery, inclusive elapsed boundaries; incomplete/failed CPU12 never normal.

warning-independent.observed: Warning and notification switches preserve independent assessment including pending/active/recovery; internal events private and bounded.

trend-window-and-gap.observed: Existing 10s EMA OLS, 3 points,80% coverage,0.02C/s stable band; insufficient distinct; current segment and same-series source epoch isolated.

receipt-replay-and-expiry.observed: Matching Receipt only; held/rejected/failed/replayed/older data do not fabricate analysis. Independent expiry rebase works with warning disabled; TTL uses observation period. Snapshot reads do not advance phases.

rule-change.observed: Threshold/duration change interrupts and waits for new Raw; warning/notification toggles do not reset; history rebuild/fatal/generation protections pass.

advice-policy.observed: All nine deterministic Core advice priorities and display wording covered. Repeated snapshots never increase observed duration; no unsafe CPU-normal inference.

coverage_note: Original TemperatureCore+SensorRuntime production denominator unchanged. Presentation/UI excluded; advice and analysis business policy inside covered Core.
scope_note: Software-only system fair/serious/critical/unknown and failure/precise timing paths; not actual thermal stress, sleep or endurance. Development RED logs remain in local staging, no valid assertions removed.
